approach: Matching decompilation with ee-gcc 2.96; splat splits the ELF, ninja relinks a byte-identical image
notes: Matching build: the linked ELF is byte-identical to retail SLUS_209.11, reproduced from a clean tree. 5,363 of 9,694 functions are in C (593,740 of 1,976,292 code bytes); the rest are assembly fallbacks. Names and types come from SMT3 HD symbol recovery. Same engine as Digital Devil Saga 1 and 2, so dds-decomp's compiler findings carry over. This is analysis and documentation, not a port: it produces the original executable, not a playable build.
